title: Aegis · Workload Health & Node State
description: TARGET board — requires the #86 telemetry-export path. Reads the intended custom table WpNodeState_CL (Workload_s, State_s, TimeGenerated), which is not emitted yet, so this board fails at query time until #86 lands. Versioned as the target schema.

list.name: subscription
list.label: Subscription
list.description: Deploy-time: set to the in-boundary subscription id (never committed).

list.name: workspace
list.label: Log Analytics workspace (resource id)
list.description: Deploy-time: set to the in-boundary Log Analytics workspace resource id (from deploy outputs).

list.name: workload
list.label: Workload
list.description: Synthetic workload scope — replace options at provision time with your in-boundary workloads.

panels.title: Nodes by state (aggregate)
panels.description: Count of workload nodes grouped by health state. Aggregate counts only — no resource identity is displayed.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Synthetic aggregate query — table name is a placeholder, rebind to your signal at provision time.
WpNodeState_CL
| where Workload_s in (${workload:singlequote})
| summarize Nodes = count() by State = State_s

panels.title: Healthy-node ratio over time
panels.description: Ratio of up nodes to total per interval. Aggregate ratio only.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
WpNodeState_CL
| where Workload_s in (${workload:singlequote})
| summarize Up = countif(State_s == 'up'), Total = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend HealthyRatio = todouble(Up) / Total
| project TimeGenerated, HealthyRatio
